scenario: Missing bearer token on protected API route
expected_result: 401 Unauthorized

scenario: Authenticated role omitted from route allowlist
expected_result: 403 Forbidden

scenario: Organization A reads Organization B resource by ID
expected_result: Not found or forbidden without data leakage; no data returned
execution_requirement: MySQL 8.4 integration test with two organizations

scenario: Organization A mutates Organization B resource by ID
expected_result: Request rejected and row unchanged
execution_requirement: MySQL 8.4 integration test with before/after row assertions

scenario: Organization context absent on tenant-owned service operation
expected_result: Fail closed before query or mutation
execution_requirement: Service unit test and HTTP integration test

scenario: Nested resource belongs to a different organization
expected_result: Reject before child mutation

scenario: Export request uses foreign tenant batch ID
expected_result: No foreign data or signed download URL returned

scenario: Missing or invalid x-device-secret on heartbeat/manifest/commands
expected_result: 401/403 and no state change

scenario: Duplicate event ID is submitted twice
expected_result: Idempotent handling; no duplicate billable/rewardable event

scenario: Device submits impossible timestamps or unknown campaign
expected_result: Event rejected or quarantined and excluded from billing/rewards

scenario: Same user creates and approves own reward/payout
expected_result: Approval rejected

scenario: Two approvers decide the same pending item concurrently
expected_result: Only one conditional transition succeeds; one audit decision

scenario: Reward policy target is not met
expected_result: Payable amount remains zero and calculation cannot be approved as eligible

scenario: Provider callback replay or stale callback
expected_result: Reject replay/stale callback without ledger mutation

scenario: Statement amount/reference mismatch
expected_result: Discrepancy recorded for human review; no automatic ledger settlement

scenario: Live provider transfer flag absent or release checks incomplete
expected_result: Transfer execution blocked
execution_requirement: Negative release-gate test and live-provider mock test

scenario: Untrusted upload URL points to private IP/metadata service
expected_result: Reject URL before fetch; no outbound request
execution_requirement: Security integration test after SSRF remediation

scenario: Multiple API replicas run scheduler concurrently
expected_result: Single logical assignment per scheduled window
execution_requirement: Multi-process integration test after distributed locking/outbox hardening

scenario: Unauthorized export/finance decision attempted
expected_result: Denied action is logged without secrets or sensitive payloads

scenario: Fresh disposable MySQL 8.4 database applies all migrations
expected_result: Migration completes and schema validates

scenario: Required tests/builds or finance approvals are missing
expected_result: Release gate remains blocked
